raw_segments.text: This conversation took place in the passage on the stairs.
Eswedragalov looked intently at Raskolnikov, and suddenly, after a brief pause, dropping
But how is it Rodian Romanovitch, you don't seem yourself?
You look and you listen, but you don't seem to understand.
I've so much to do of my own business and other people's.
Ah, Rodian Romanovitch, he added suddenly, what all men need is fresh air, fresh air,
He added suddenly, what all men need is fresh air, more than anything.
